content: We utilize fasttext BIBREF18 to generate the embeddings of all words from both Text-SQuAD and Spoken-SQuAD. We adopt the phoneme sequence embeddings to replace the original character sequence embeddings using the method proposed by Li et al. BIBREF5 . The source domain model and the target domain model share the same set of word embedding matrix to improve the alignment between these two domains.
